capture.note: each case runs twice on fresh ExifTool objects with `members` and `options` set and SetByteOrder(byte_order): FoundTag($tagInfo, val) then GetValue(key, 'ValueConv') gives `vc`; FoundTag then GetValue(key, 'PrintConv') gives `pc`, and that run's member changes (`set`, `deleted` for a removed one) and Warn requests (`warnings`).
